full_name: Marta Gentilucci | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Arts Rieman and Baketel Fellow for Music Institut de Recherche et de Coordination Acoustique/Musique (France)
bio: Marta Gentilucci’s work focuses on the musical implications that vocal and electronic music have on the creation of physical sonic spaces, on the musical elements that inhabit these spaces, and the listener's physical perception of them
